fee_notes: 7% royalty on Gross Sales within Designated Territory; 8% on Outside Gross Sales. Minimum Annual Royalty (Move): $16,100/Zone yr1 escalating to $28,673/Zone yr10. Minimum Annual Royalty (Junk): $8,050/Zone yr1 escalating to $14,337/Zone yr10. SLC Appointment Fee: 6% gross sales for junk appointments, 5% for move appointments booked by SLC. Brand Development Fee: 2% gross sales. Local advertising: greater of $1,500/mo or 8% gross sales (move); $1,100/mo or 8% (junk). Technology Fee: 1% gross sales capped at $35,000/yr. ACUTE FS: $380-$580/mo (up to $1,250 for premium). Payroll Services (optional): $299-$2,299/mo.
raw_excerpt: Continuing Royalty Fee 7% of Gross Sales... Brand Development Fee 2% of Gross Sales... Technology Fee 1% of Gross Sales
